note: Each month in H1 2025 exceeded its 2024 counterpart: 812 notices versus 385.
limitations: The monthly counts are a frozen 2026-07-27 snapshot; the live dataset and reporting may later change.
These are filed eviction notices, not court filings or completed evictions.

series.query: SELECT date_extract_y(file_date) AS year, date_extract_m(file_date) AS month, count(*) AS notices WHERE file_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01T00:00:00' AND '2025-06-30T23:59:59' GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year, month
